using System;
using System.Net;
using System.Net.Security;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
using Moq;
using Xunit;
using Garnet.cluster;

namespace Garnet.Tests.cluster
{
    public class GarnetServerNodeTests
    {
        // We will test the logging of LogWarning on the logger when gossipTask is faulted.
        // To do this, we need to simulate the gossipTask being faulted and the logger being called.

        // Since the method containing the LogWarning call is not public, we will test the public method that leads to that call.
        // The code snippet is from a method that checks gossipTask status and logs warning if faulted.
        // We will simulate the faulted task and verify the logger call.

        // We will create mocks for dependencies: ClusterProvider, ILogger, EndPoint, SslClientAuthenticationOptions, LightEpoch.

        // We will create a derived class to expose the method that contains the LogWarning call for testing.

        class TestGarnetServerNode : GarnetServerNode
        {
            public TestGarnetServerNode(ClusterProvider clusterProvider, EndPoint endpoint, SslClientAuthenticationOptions tlsOptions, LightEpoch epoch, ILogger logger)
                : base(clusterProvider, endpoint, tlsOptions, epoch, logger)
            {
            }

            // Expose a method to simulate the gossipTask faulted scenario and call the code that logs warning.
            public bool TestTryGossipWithFaultedTask(Task faultedTask)
            {
                // We simulate the code snippet logic here:
                var task = faultedTask;
                if (task == null)
                {
                    return true;
                }
                else if (task.Status == TaskStatus.RanToCompletion)
                {
                    return true;
                }
                logger?.LogWarning(task.Exception, "GOSSIP round faulted");
                ResetCts();
                return false;
            }
        }

        [Fact]
        public void LogWarning_Is_Called_When_GossipTask_Is_Faulted()
        {
            // Arrange
            var mockLogger = new Mock<ILogger>();
            var mockClusterProvider = new Mock<ClusterProvider>();
            var mockClusterManager = new Mock<dynamic>();
            var mockStoreWrapper = new Mock<dynamic>();
            var mockReplicationManager = new Mock<dynamic>();

            // Setup clusterProvider and its nested properties to avoid null refs
            mockClusterProvider.SetupGet(cp => cp.storeWrapper).Returns(mockStoreWrapper.Object);
            mockClusterProvider.SetupGet(cp => cp.clusterManager).Returns(mockClusterManager.Object);
            mockClusterManager.SetupGet(cm => cm.clusterProvider).Returns(mockClusterProvider.Object);
            mockClusterManager.SetupGet(cm => cm.gossipStats).Returns(new object());
            mockClusterManager.SetupGet(cm => cm.ctsGossip).Returns(new System.Threading.CancellationTokenSource());
            mockClusterManager.SetupGet(cm => cm.gossipDelay).Returns(TimeSpan.FromSeconds(1));
            mockClusterManager.SetupGet(cm => cm.clusterTimeout).Returns(TimeSpan.FromSeconds(1));
            mockClusterProvider.SetupGet(cp => cp.replicationManager).Returns(mockReplicationManager.Object);
            mockStoreWrapper.SetupGet(sw => sw.serverOptions).Returns(new { DisablePubSub = true, PubSubPageSizeBytes = new Func<int>(() => 1024), ClusterTimeout = 1 });

            var endpoint = new IPEndPoint(IPAddress.Loopback, 12345);
            var tlsOptions = new SslClientAuthenticationOptions();
            var epoch = new LightEpoch();

            var node = new TestGarnetServerNode(mockClusterProvider.Object, endpoint, tlsOptions, epoch, mockLogger.Object);

            // Create a faulted task with an exception
            var tcs = new TaskCompletionSource<bool>();
            tcs.SetException(new InvalidOperationException("Test exception"));
            var faultedTask = tcs.Task;

            // Act
            var result = node.TestTryGossipWithFaultedTask(faultedTask);

            // Assert
            Assert.False(result);
            mockLogger.Verify(
                x => x.Log(
                    LogLevel.Warning,
                    It.IsAny<EventId>(),
                    It.Is<It.IsAnyType>((v, t) => v.ToString().Contains("GOSSIP round faulted") || v.ToString().Contains("Test exception")),
                    It.IsAny<Exception>(),
                    It.IsAny<Func<It.IsAnyType, Exception, string>>()),
                Times.Once);
        }
    }
}
